practiceQuestions.prompt: In linear regression, what does the least-squares method minimise?
practiceQuestions.explanation: Least squares minimises the sum of the squared vertical distances between each observed point and the fitted line.

options.label: The number of features in the model
The slope of the regression line

practiceQuestions.prompt: Which of these can cause a model to overfit? Select all that apply.
practiceQuestions.explanation: Too many parameters relative to the data, and training for too long without regularisation, both let the model memorise noise. More training data generally reduces overfitting.

options.label: Too many parameters for the amount of data
Training for too many epochs without regularisation
Leaving test data in the training set

practiceQuestions.prompt: A high R-squared value always means the model will generalise well to new data.
practiceQuestions.explanation: False. R-squared measures fit on the data you already have. A model can fit training data almost perfectly and still fail on new data.
